scope: Exactly38 byte-identical raw country files from local copies only; no downloads or expansion after values.
comparison_unit: Full original bbox daytime detections before commune assignment, not only municipal detections.
primary: EXCEPT ALL in both directions over all13 columns, no rounding/tolerance added.
reference_scope: Terra/Aqua2002-01-01..2025-12-31; SNPP2012-01-01..2025-12-31, no source_kind restriction on reference.
read_semantics: Separate MODIS and SNPP read_csv file lists; header=true, union_by_name=true, filename=true, all_varchar=true. Original strict casts, bbox and daynight filtering.
dedup_semantics: SAT normalized; row_number partition sat,round(lat,4),round(lon,4),date,lpad(time,4), ordered solely source priority. Rank before confidence exactly as original.
tie_policy: Report repeated keys and distinct payloads. Nonidentical same-priority ties expose nondeterminism; no new tie-break or winner selected to force equality.
parse_integrity: Validate full-file count/min/max against inventory, then strict parser; parse failures are failures, not coercion repairs.
limitations: Completeness only relative to frozen inventory, not observation opportunity or true fire.
No commune assignment, static-mask rebuild, calibration or publication rerun. MissingTerra2000/2001 and NOAA20/21 prevent whole-pipeline raw reproduction.
A successful projection onto canonical13 columns is not invertibility of all raw fields or validation of source-priority alternatives.
isolated_database: DuckDB in-memory only; only scratch outputs under assigned audit folder. Never import legacy script or open goliat.duckdb.
